name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small bathroom feel more spacious, consider several design strategies. Light-colored tiles and paint can brighten the room. Wall-mounted vanities and toilets free up floor space. Large mirrors can create an illusion of depth, and a glass shower enclosure instead of a curtain can open up the area. Strategic lighting, including recessed lights and sconces, also helps to expand the perceived size of the room.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use light colors, wall-mounted fixtures, large mirrors, glass shower enclosures, and strategic lighting to make a small bathroom feel larger.
